title: Survey finding only about 30% of physicists accept the standard model

tellings.quote: And the survey recently showed that adherence to the standard model is only about 30%

plain: A recent survey found that only about 30 percent of physicists still hold to the standard model, the accepted mainstream theory in their field. Jeffrey Mishlove, a parapsychologist and longtime interviewer, cites this to Michels without naming the survey. He uses it to suggest that mainstream science is less settled than it looks.
